# MapLibre iOS 5.12.2 notices

LICENSE.md is copied from the exact source release used by the pinned binary package:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplibre/maplibre-native/ios-v5.12.2/platform/ios/LICENSE.md

Retrieved 2026-10-23; trailing whitespace normalized. This includes the iOS SDK and its bundled third-party notices. The historical maplibre-gl-native repository redirects to maplibre-native.

The resolved distribution Package.swift downloads:
https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-native/releases/download/ios-v5.12.2/Mapbox-5.12.2.zip

Its SwiftPM SHA-256 checksum is `348453495bad198b380e033a6bc6e6134bf71be27116904a25152b93a2d77491`.

Tools/update_dependency_notices.py uses this checked-in notice only when the package manifest matches that exact version and checksum. Refresh the notices when upgrading the binary.
